releases.notes:
Fixes the client stopping as soon as Wry is picked on LiquidBounce nextgen builds from 2 October 2026 on, where accelerated paint moved into the CEF add-on. Needs one of those builds.

On Linux, install WebKitGTK first, for example `sudo pacman -S webkit2gtk-4.1` or `sudo apt install libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0`.

mods.name: LiquidBounce Wry
mods.description: Lets you show the client's menus with the web view built into your system, through Wry, instead of the built-in Chromium.

releases.notes:
First release.

Shows LiquidBounce's menus with the web view that comes with your system instead of the built-in Chromium: WebView2 on Windows, WKWebView on macOS and WebKitGTK on Linux. After installing it, the client asks which browser to use on its next start. Hold Shift while it starts to choose again.

Needs LiquidBounce 0.40.1, or a nextgen build from 26 September 2026 on. On Linux, install WebKitGTK first, for example `sudo pacman -S webkit2gtk-4.1` or `sudo apt install libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0`.

Try it and tell us how it runs on your system.

readmeSummary: A LiquidBounce add-on that lets the client show its menus with the web view that comes with your system, through Wry, instead of the built-in Chromium.
